# Vaishnavi Jewels (Vaishnavi Gem & Jewel Pvt Ltd)

> Fine jewellery showroom and manufacturer in Surat, Gujarat, India, since 1 June 2005. Natural diamond jewellery, lab-grown diamond jewellery, Polki, Jadau and bridal jewellery. Made in-house; free insured delivery to major Indian cities.

- Address: 120, Rajhans Ornate - High Street Retail Mall, Parle Point, Surat, Gujarat 395007, India
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 11 AM to 8 PM; closed Sunday
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 75674 00099
- Email: vaishnaviexim@gmail.com
- Founder: Shilpi Agarwal
